purpose: Inspection and annotation preparation only; no population benchmark or agent score

source.name: ReDial
source.citation: Li et al. (2018), Towards Deep Conversational Recommendations, NeurIPS 31.

selection: SHA256(seed:conversationId) order, greedy pairwise-disjoint initiator/respondent workers
prefix: Before first respondent message containing a tagged movie ID; end at last preceding seeker message
labels: Original post-dialogue questionnaires in a separate file, never agent inputs or prefix truth
split: Single inspection cohort; exclude all conversations sharing any selected worker from a later evaluation
